final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.location AS event_location, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / b.amount) AS average FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT link_to_event, event_location, average, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_location ORDER BY average DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM grouped) SELECT link_to_event, event_location, average, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3
